name: Crow
source: An intelligent orcish translator and guide for travelling through Skagen. Crow is very meak, a common trait in 'half-blood' orcs. She's a lot more sociable than Glasha, and her linguistic talents raise a lot of questions. Where did she learn not one, but multiple languages? Crow could doubtlessly work for a legitimate institute or a noble house, but instead prefers to work with mercenaries. Her skills were vital in procuring the means to transport Carmen from Anghor Bay to Whitewood without raising suspicion.
